title: Native GitHub webhook wake latency probe
objective: Prove that a GitHub pull-request comment can wake the persistent ChatGPT Work orchestration surface without hourly polling.
constraints: Read-only with respect to GitHub after the trigger fires.
Do not inspect or mutate CI.
Deliver the result into the same Work conversation where the event-triggered task was created if the product supports it.
pass_condition: The exact Work response appears promptly after the exact GitHub comment event, without waiting for an hourly poll.
